ops.old:
Click(ic, "LeftButton")
    local w = B.Window()
    check("beacon: a click opens the report window", w ~= nil and w:IsShown())
    check("beacon: the window holds the report text", (w.box:GetText() or ""):find("Zz beacon line 5.", 1, true) ~= nil, w.box:GetText())
    check("beacon: the window says the icon is on, in Persian", non_ascii(w.status:GetText()), w.status:GetText())
    Click(w.toggle)
    check("beacon: the window button turns the icon off", B.IsOn() == false and not ic:IsShown())
    Click(w.toggle)
    check("beacon: and on again", B.IsOn() == true and ic:IsShown())
    Click(w.clear)
ops.new:
F:Miss("npc", "zz beacon npc", "Zz Beacon Npc")
    Click(ic, "LeftButton")
    local w = B.Window()
    check("beacon: a click opens a small page next to the icon", w ~= nil and w:IsShown())
    check("beacon: the page says what the report helps, in Persian", non_ascii(w.summary:GetText()), w.summary:GetText())
    local cnt = B.Counts()
    check("beacon: the counts are by group", cnt.spell == 1 and cnt.npc == 1, tostring(cnt.spell) .. "/" .. tostring(cnt.npc))
    check("beacon: the page holds the report text", (w.box:GetText() or ""):find("Zz beacon line 5.", 1, true) ~= nil, w.box:GetText())
    Click(w.site)
    check("beacon: the site button puts the address in the box", (w.box:GetText() or ""):find("/report", 1, true) ~= nil
        and not (w.box:GetText() or ""):find("Zz beacon line", 1, true), w.box:GetText())
    Click(w.copy)
    check("beacon: the copy button puts the report back", (w.box:GetText() or ""):find("Zz beacon line 5.", 1, true) ~= nil)
    Click(ic, "LeftButton")
    check("beacon: a second click closes the page", not w:IsShown())
    Click(ic, "LeftButton")
    check("beacon: and a third opens it again", w:IsShown())
    Click(w.clear)
